server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Shown in the in-game server browser.

server_description.title: Description
server_description.description: Shown in the server details panel and connection chat.

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Maximum number of players that can join this V Rising server.

max_admins.title: Reserved Admin Slots
max_admins.description: Admins allowed to connect even when the server is full.

server_password.title: Join Password
server_password.description: Optional password players must enter before joining the server.

hide_ip_address.title: Hide IP Address
hide_ip_address.description: Advertise through relay services instead of showing the direct IP.

secure_mode.title: VAC Secure Mode
secure_mode.description: Enables the VAC-secured server mode used by the dedicated server.

list_on_eos.title: List On EOS
list_on_eos.description: Registers the server on the EOS browser, which V Rising clients use by default. This only controls discovery; joining still requires the game UDP Port to be reachable.

save_name.title: Save Folder Name
save_name.description: Name of the save directory inside the persistent data root.

game_difficulty.title: Difficulty
game_difficulty.description: Uses the same Easy, Normal, and Brutal names shipped in the official V Rising difficulty presets.

game_mode_type.title: Game Mode
game_mode_type.description: Switches between PvE and PvP rule sets using the current V Rising string values.

castle_damage_mode.title: Castle Damage Mode
castle_damage_mode.description: Controls whether castles can be damaged at all or only during scheduled siege windows.

siege_weapon_health.title: Siege Weapon Health
siege_weapon_health.description: Controls how durable siege weapons are once deployed.

player_damage_mode.title: Player Damage Mode
player_damage_mode.description: Controls whether player-vs-player damage is always active or limited to the PvP schedule below.

castle_heart_damage_mode.title: Castle Heart Damage Mode
castle_heart_damage_mode.description: Controls whether hearts can only decay, be destroyed, or be seized by players.

pvp_protection_mode.title: PvP Protection Mode
pvp_protection_mode.description: Controls the startup protection applied to newly active players.

death_container_permission.title: Death Container Permission
death_container_permission.description: Controls who can loot dropped death containers.

relic_spawn_type.title: Relic Spawn Type
relic_spawn_type.description: Controls whether soul shard relics stay unique or appear more widely.

can_loot_enemy_containers.title: Loot Enemy Containers
can_loot_enemy_containers.description: Allows players to loot containers owned by enemy players or clans.

blood_bound_equipment.title: Blood Bound Equipment
blood_bound_equipment.description: Keeps equipped gear blood-bound instead of dropping on death.

teleport_bound_items.title: Teleport Bound Items
teleport_bound_items.description: Controls whether bound items can travel through vampire waygates and cave passages.

bat_bound_items.title: Bat Bound Items
bat_bound_items.description: Controls whether bound items can be carried while using bat form travel.

bat_bound_shards.title: Bat Bound Shards
bat_bound_shards.description: Controls whether soul shards can be carried while using bat form travel.

allow_global_chat.title: Allow Global Chat
allow_global_chat.description: Allows players to speak in the global chat channel.

all_waypoints_unlocked.title: Unlock All Waygates
all_waypoints_unlocked.description: Starts players with all vampire waygates unlocked.

free_castle_claim.title: Free Castle Claim
free_castle_claim.description: Allows eligible players to claim castles without the normal cost.

free_castle_raid.title: Free Castle Raid
free_castle_raid.description: Allows castle raids without the normal key or cost requirement.

free_castle_destroy.title: Free Castle Destroy
free_castle_destroy.description: Allows castles to be destroyed without the normal cost requirement.

inactivity_kill_enabled.title: Enable Inactivity Kill
inactivity_kill_enabled.description: Allows V Rising to remove inactive vampires after the configured inactivity window.

inactivity_kill_time_min.title: Inactivity Kill Min Seconds
inactivity_kill_time_min.description: Minimum inactivity time in seconds before the inactive vampire cleanup can apply.

inactivity_kill_time_max.title: Inactivity Kill Max Seconds
inactivity_kill_time_max.description: Maximum inactivity time in seconds used by the inactive vampire cleanup window.

inactivity_kill_safe_time_addition.title: Inactivity Safe Time Bonus
inactivity_kill_safe_time_addition.description: Extra safe time in seconds added before inactivity cleanup can remove a character.

inactivity_kill_timer_max_item_level.title: Inactivity Max Item Level
inactivity_kill_timer_max_item_level.description: Highest item level that can still be affected by inactivity cleanup timers.

starting_progression_level.title: Starting Progression Level
starting_progression_level.description: Baseline progression level applied to newly created characters on this server.

weapon_slots.title: Weapon Slots
weapon_slots.description: Number of weapon slots available to players.

disable_disconnected_dead_enabled.title: Disable Disconnected Dead
disable_disconnected_dead_enabled.description: Controls whether disconnected dead players are cleaned up by the server timer.

disable_disconnected_dead_timer.title: Disconnected Dead Timer
disable_disconnected_dead_timer.description: Timer in seconds for disconnected dead player cleanup.

disconnected_sun_immunity_time.title: Disconnect Sun Immunity
disconnected_sun_immunity_time.description: Seconds of sunlight immunity granted after a player disconnects.

inventory_stacks_modifier.title: Inventory Stack Modifier
inventory_stacks_modifier.description: Multiplier applied to stack sizes in player inventories and containers.

material_yield_modifier_global.title: Material Yield Modifier
material_yield_modifier_global.description: Global multiplier for gathered material yield.

blood_essence_yield_modifier.title: Blood Essence Yield Modifier
blood_essence_yield_modifier.description: Multiplier for blood essence drops and yield.

drop_table_modifier_general.title: General Loot Modifier
drop_table_modifier_general.description: Multiplier applied to general world loot tables.

drop_table_modifier_missions.title: Mission Loot Modifier
drop_table_modifier_missions.description: Multiplier applied to servant mission rewards.

drop_table_modifier_stygian_shards.title: Stygian Shard Loot Modifier
drop_table_modifier_stygian_shards.description: Multiplier applied to Stygian shard drops.

soul_shard_durability_loss_rate.title: Soul Shard Durability Loss
soul_shard_durability_loss_rate.description: Multiplier for soul shard durability loss.

journal_vblood_source_unit_max_distance.title: V Blood Journal Tracking Distance
journal_vblood_source_unit_max_distance.description: Maximum distance used to track V Blood source units in the journal.

pvp_vampire_respawn_modifier.title: PvP Respawn Modifier
pvp_vampire_respawn_modifier.description: Multiplier applied to vampire respawn time after PvP deaths.

castle_minimum_distance_in_floors.title: Castle Min Distance (Floors)
castle_minimum_distance_in_floors.description: Minimum build spacing between castle hearts, measured in floor tiles.

clan_size.title: Clan Size
clan_size.description: Maximum number of players allowed in one clan.

blood_drain_modifier.title: Blood Drain Modifier
blood_drain_modifier.description: Multiplier for how quickly vampire blood drains over time.

durability_drain_modifier.title: Durability Drain Modifier
durability_drain_modifier.description: Multiplier for durability loss from regular gameplay.

holy_area_strength_modifier.title: Holy Area Strength Modifier
holy_area_strength_modifier.description: Multiplier for holy area exposure strength.

castle_limit.title: Castle Heart Limit
castle_limit.description: How many castle hearts a player or clan can own at the same time.

nether_gate_limit.title: Nether Gate Limit
nether_gate_limit.description: Maximum number of nether gates allowed per castle.

throne_of_darkness_limit.title: Throne Of Darkness Limit
throne_of_darkness_limit.description: Maximum number of Thrones of Darkness allowed per castle.

arena_station_limit.title: Arena Station Limit
arena_station_limit.description: Maximum number of arena stations allowed per castle.

routing_station_limit.title: Routing Station Limit
routing_station_limit.description: Maximum number of routing stations allowed per castle.

castle_decay_rate_modifier.title: Castle Decay Rate Modifier
castle_decay_rate_modifier.description: Multiplier for castle decay when the heart is not maintained.

castle_blood_essence_drain_modifier.title: Castle Blood Essence Drain Modifier
castle_blood_essence_drain_modifier.description: Multiplier for how quickly castle hearts consume blood essence.

castle_siege_timer.title: Castle Siege Timer
castle_siege_timer.description: Duration in seconds for the active castle siege state.

castle_under_attack_timer.title: Castle Under Attack Timer
castle_under_attack_timer.description: Duration in seconds that a castle remains flagged as under attack.

castle_raid_timer.title: Castle Raid Timer
castle_raid_timer.description: Duration in seconds for raid state after a siege interaction.

castle_raid_protection_time.title: Castle Raid Protection Time
castle_raid_protection_time.description: Protection time in seconds applied after a raid window.

castle_exposed_free_claim_timer.title: Castle Exposed Free Claim Timer
castle_exposed_free_claim_timer.description: Time in seconds before an exposed castle can be freely claimed.

castle_relocation_cooldown.title: Castle Relocation Cooldown
castle_relocation_cooldown.description: Cooldown in seconds before a player can relocate a castle again.

castle_relocation_enabled.title: Enable Castle Relocation
castle_relocation_enabled.description: Allows players to relocate castle hearts when V Rising supports the feature.

announce_siege_weapon_spawn.title: Announce Siege Weapon Spawn

show_siege_weapon_map_icon.title: Show Siege Weapon Map Icon
show_siege_weapon_map_icon.description: Shows spawned siege weapons on the map.

build_cost_modifier.title: Build Cost Modifier
build_cost_modifier.description: Multiplier for building placement resource cost.

recipe_cost_modifier.title: Recipe Cost Modifier
recipe_cost_modifier.description: Multiplier for crafting recipe resource cost.

dismantle_resource_modifier.description: Multiplier applied to resources returned from dismantling. V Rising clamps this field to the 0.0-1.0 range.

death_durability_factor_loss.title: Death Durability Loss

server_game_settings_json.title: Advanced ServerGameSettings.json Overrides
server_game_settings_json.description: Use this escape hatch for unsupported gameplay fields. Typed controls sync into this JSON automatically.

list_on_steam.title: List On Steam
list_on_steam.description: Publishes the server in the Steam browser and enables Steam player queries. When disabled, player queries are unavailable; players can still join through the game UDP port. EOS listing is controlled separately.

server_fps.title: Server FPS
server_fps.description: Simulation tick target used by the dedicated server process.

game_settings_preset.title: Game Settings Preset
game_settings_preset.description: Optional preset filename stem from the installed GameSettingPresets folder. Leave blank to keep the explicit field overrides below.

game_difficulty_preset.title: Game Difficulty Preset
game_difficulty_preset.description: Optional difficulty preset filename stem from the installed V Rising data files. Leave blank to control difficulty directly.

player_interaction_time_zone.title: Schedule Time Zone
player_interaction_time_zone.description: Interprets the weekday and weekend PvP windows using either local server time or UTC.

starter_equipment_id.title: Starter Equipment ID
starter_equipment_id.description: Optional starter gear prefab ID. Official level presets use these values for boosted starts.

starter_resources_id.title: Starter Resources ID
starter_resources_id.description: Optional starter resource bundle ID used by V Rising's level-start presets.

castle_tick_period.title: Castle Tick Period
castle_tick_period.description: Base heartbeat interval for castle systems inside the global castle stat block.

safety_box_limit.title: Safety Box Limit
safety_box_limit.description: Maximum number of safety boxes allowed per castle.

eye_structures_limit.title: Eye Structure Limit
eye_structures_limit.description: Maximum number of Eye structures allowed per castle.

tomb_limit.title: Tomb Limit

prison_cell_limit.title: Prison Cell Limit

castle_heart_limit_type.title: Castle Heart Limit Scope

compress_save_files.title: Compress Save Files
compress_save_files.description: Stores save archives compressed on disk inside the instance-owned persistent root.

admin_only_debug_events.title: Admin Only Debug Events
admin_only_debug_events.description: Restricts debug event access to administrators.

disable_debug_events.title: Disable Debug Events
disable_debug_events.description: Disables debug event access on the server.

api_enabled.title: Enable Server API
api_enabled.description: Turns on V Rising's built-in server API listener using the default bind and port.

lower_fps_when_empty.title: Reduce FPS When Empty
lower_fps_when_empty.description: Reduce the server simulation frame rate while no players are connected. Leave unset to use the native default.

lower_fps_when_empty_value.title: Empty Server FPS
lower_fps_when_empty_value.description: Simulation frames per second when empty-server FPS reduction is enabled. Leave unset to use the native default.

lan_mode.title: LAN Mode
lan_mode.description: Enable the dedicated server LAN mode. Leave unset to use the native default.

safe_reconnect_time.title: Reconnect Reservation Time (Seconds)
safe_reconnect_time.description: How long to reserve reconnection slots for recently disconnected players.

safe_reconnect_slots.title: Reserved Reconnect Slots
safe_reconnect_slots.description: Number of slots reserved for recently disconnected players so they can reconnect when the server fills up. Leave unset to use the native default.
